node.title: https oddity
node.author: huck
node.doctext: A google search [https://www.google.com/search?sclient=psy-ab&btnG=Search&q=%22sub+Switch%22+perl+%22Goto+out+of+Sub%22+] showed me this post [https://www.perlmonks.org/?node_id=291389] which when clicked (in firefox) took me to an intercept Your connection is not secure The owner of www.perlmonks.org has configured their website improperly. To protect your information from being stolen, Firefox has not connected to this website. Clicking advanced showed me www.perlmonks.org uses an invalid security certificate. The certificate is only valid for the following names: *.pair.com, pair.com Just FYI , i think, taking the s off https worked just fine
